rules.statement: A Notary Public who attested a Deed cannot be regarded as an attesting witness for the purposes of Section 68 of the Evidence Ordinance if he does not know the executant of the Deed.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore, the fact that, the Notary Public did not state in his Attestation that he knew the executants, leads compellingly to the conclusion that, he did not know the executants.
